stack:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Recursively constructs a valid removal sequence by repeatedly removing an element equal to its current 1-based position from b, storing the sequence in a, and indicating failure with -1 when no valid sequence exists." stack]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> b </REF>: int* "Pointer to the current input array of length m to process."
        <REF> a </REF>: int* "Pointer to the output array where the resulting sequence is stored."
        <REF> m </REF>: int "Positive integer length of the current input array b."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> a </REF>: int* "Output array containing the chosen sequence; a -1 in the last written position indicates that no valid sequence exists for that subproblem."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND If m equals 1, set a[0] to 1 when b[0] equals 1, otherwise set a[0] to -1; no further processing occurs for this call. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If m does not equal 1, scan i from 0 through m - 1 inclusive, breaking as soon as b[i] > i + 1. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND If the first scan stopped with i not equal to m, set a[m - 1] = -1 and skip the recursive search for this m. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If the first scan completed with i equal to m, set flag = 0 and start a second loop over i from 0 through m - 1 inclusive. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND In the second loop, if b[i] is not equal to i + 1, set new_b[i] = b[i] and continue to the next i. RESULT new_b]
            [COMMAND In the second loop, if b[i] equals i + 1, for j from i + 1 through m - 1 inclusive set new_b[j - 1] = b[j]. RESULT new_b]
            [COMMAND In the second loop, after shifting the tail of b for the chosen i, recursively call stack(new_b, a, m - 1). RESULT a]
            [COMMAND After the recursive call, if a[m - 2] equals -1, restore new_b[i] = b[i] and continue with the next i; otherwise set a[m - 1] = i + 1, set flag = 1, and break out of the second loop. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If the second loop finishes with flag still equal to 0, set a[m - 1] = -1. RESULT a]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
